admin.users.add_help: Create an account and choose its system role.
admin.users.project_roles_help: Project roles are set in project settings.
admin.users.change_hint: Changing the role, password or enabled state signs out existing logins. The admin account cannot be demoted or disabled.
admin.attach.title: Message attachments
admin.attach.intro: Allow sessions to send files to each other.
admin.attach.turn_off_aria: Turn off message attachments and delete server files
admin.attach.disk_caption: Volume that stores attachments · Value when the page was opened
admin.attach.status_unknown: Server disk: free space cannot be checked, so new attachments are not accepted.
admin.attach.status_low: Less than 1 GiB is free, so new attachments are not accepted.
admin.attach.detail_off_full: Attachments are off, so the attachment files on the server were deleted. Messages are still delivered.
admin.attach.detail_full: Stored attachments can still be downloaded, and messages are still delivered.
admin.attach.detail_off: Check the free server disk space before turning this on. Turning it off also deletes attachment files left on the server.
admin.attach.detail_on: If less than 1 GiB is free, only new uploads stop.
admin.scope.title: Restricted and automatic-registration tokens
admin.scope.turn_off_aria: Turn off restricted and automatic-registration tokens
admin.scope.turn_on_aria: Turn on restricted and automatic-registration tokens
admin.scope.desc: Restricted tokens need client 0.15 or later. Turning this off blocks new restricted and automatic tokens and automatic registration. Existing tokens stay.
admin.http.title: HTTP connections
admin.http.desc: HTTP is not encrypted. Allow client HTTP connections only on networks you trust.
admin.http.meta: A change makes open connections check the policy again.
admin.announce.title: Administrator announcement
admin.announce.desc: Sent as broker-admin to sessions that are ready to receive. Replies are not available.
admin.announce.help: Up to 12,000 bytes. Sessions that are not ready or whose queue (32 messages) is full are shown as failed.
admin.announce.error_body: Enter the announcement and keep it within the 12,000-byte envelope limit.
admin.announce.error_failed: Could not submit the announcement. Check its size and the target project.
admin.announce.error_forbidden: Check your permission to send announcements again.
admin.announce.duplicate: Already submitted. The same announcement was not submitted again.
admin.announce.error_sessions_unavailabl: Could not read the project sessions.
admin.announce.error_unavailable: Announcements are not available for this project.
admin.announce.error_not_accepted: The session did not accept it. Check its connection.
admin.announce.pending: The announcement is still being submitted.
admin.http.error_save: Could not save the HTTP connection policy.
admin.scope.error_save: Could not save the token issuance setting.
admin.api.error_save: Could not save the Management API setting.
admin.api.title: Management API
admin.api.intro: A REST API that agents and scripts use with user API tokens to manage the server.
admin.api.confirm_off: Apart from the public specification /api/v1/openapi.json, every /api/v1 request is refused at once. Existing tokens stay and work again when it is turned back on. Turn off the Management API?
admin.api.confirm_on: Allows /api/v1 management requests with user API tokens. Agents and scripts with a token can manage the server within its scopes. Turn on the Management API?
admin.api.off_1: When off, apart from the public specification
admin.api.off_3: request is refused at once. Existing tokens stay and work again when it is turned back on.
admin.api.detail_on: Agents and scripts can send management requests with user API tokens, within each token's scopes.
admin.api.detail_off: Existing tokens do not work for now. Only requests are blocked; tokens are not deleted.
admin.api_tokens.title: API tokens
admin.api_tokens.intro: Tokens that {name} issued. Administrators cannot issue tokens for other users.
admin.api_tokens.issued_help: Shows tokens that have not expired.
admin.api_tokens.revoke_all_desc: Revoke every API token of {name}. Agents and scripts using them stop working at once. This cannot be undone. Revoke all?
admin.api_tokens.caption: API tokens of {name}
admin.api_tokens.label: Label
admin.api_tokens.revoke_desc: Revoke the API token {label} of {name}. Agents and scripts using it stop working at once. This cannot be undone. Revoke it?
admin.api_tokens.empty_help: Users can issue their own tokens in My profile.
